summary: Iteration 8 (Twilio Verify + Razorpay + Theme + Logo) PASSED. Auth enforcement on /bookings/order, /bookings/verify, /bookings verified. Frontend (Playwright, 390x844): (1) login: '+919999900000' → send OTP → dev-code-box shows 'Test code (demo number): 123456' → OTP filled → verify → landed on Today tab greeting 'Good morning, Demo'. (2) Me → Appearance: me-theme-system/light/dark all present; switching to Dark re-themed the entire screen (dark surfaces, light text) then Light restored the warm cream/indigo palette, then back to System — no crashes across screens. (3) Support → Find a psychologist → Dr. Ananya Rao → session-type-15-min Call (₹400) → slot → confirm-pay-button opens the RazorpayCheckout Modal (rzp-close visible, WebView container mounted as iframe). Order creation succeeded (no booking-error). On web preview react-native-webview logs 'React Native WebView does not support this platform.' inside the iframe body — this is the library's web-preview stub; on native builds (Expo Go / native iOS/Android) the actual Razorpay checkout HTML renders. Modal open behaviour is correct per spec ('verify it opens; do NOT complete a card payment').

react_native_issues.issue: react-native-webview on web renders the RazorpayCheckout Modal frame but its body shows 'React Native WebView does not support this platform.' The Modal opens correctly (rzp-close button visible, iframe mounted) so the frontend integration point works; the actual Razorpay checkout HTML only renders on native builds. This is a known platform limitation of react-native-webview, not a bug in this codebase. Reference: /app/frontend/src/RazorpayCheckout.tsx:86.

Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"'. Emitted by shadow* props on the mood tile Views on web. Cosmetic, non-blocking on native. Reference: /app/frontend/src/MoodSelector.tsx (shadowColor/Offset/Opacity/Radius).

Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — likely from a Pressable or View using the pointerEvents prop. Non-blocking. Consider moving to style.pointerEvents in a follow-up pass.

action_items: None blocking. Optional cleanup: swap shadow* props for boxShadow on web via Platform.OS gating; migrate props.pointerEvents to style.pointerEvents.

Note for main agent: to fully exercise the Razorpay WebView on native, use Expo Go or a dev-client build; automated tests on web preview can only verify that the RazorpayCheckout Modal opens, which is confirmed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _ensure_indian_phone (line 588-599): correctly rejects <10 digits, non-Indian countries, and Indian numbers with leading digit not in 6-9. Verified via tests reject_short_non_indian_number / reject_us_number / reject_indian_leading_5.
server.py request_otp (line 685-696): TEST_PHONES bypass returns dev_code only for whitelisted +919999900000; real numbers go through Twilio Verify and never return dev_code — good.

server.py bookings/verify (line 1226-1233): HMAC-SHA256 signature check uses hmac.compare_digest (constant-time). On mismatch the booking is flipped to status='failed' before 400. Confirmed via test_verify_rejects_fabricated_signature.
server.py list_bookings (line 1252-1258): queries status $in [confirmed, cancelled] — pending orders correctly hidden. Confirmed via test_pending_booking_not_in_list.

RazorpayCheckout.tsx (line 55-105): Modal + WebView with source={{html: buildHtml(...), baseUrl: 'https://checkout.razorpay.com'}} + originWhitelist ['*'] is correct for native. handleMessage handles success/dismiss/error and forwards to onSuccess/onDismiss/onError. Testable via rzp-close and rzp-webview testIDs.
psychologist/[id].tsx startPayment (line 37-45): posts /bookings/order and stores order; onPaid (line 47-55) posts /bookings/verify — matches backend contract exactly.

me.tsx Appearance section (line 82-90): renders 3 theme pills with testIDs me-theme-{system|light|dark} calling setPref via ThemeContext. Toggling between values re-themes the app immediately (verified visually).
